visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark, slightly wavy hair and a young boy in a light green graphic t-shirt are inside a supermarket or retail space. A very large, round green watermelon sits on a shelf in the immediate foreground, filling the bottom half of the frame. The man leans in from the left, looking closely at the fruit. (2) The man leans his head down, placing his ear against the watermelon's skin while patting its surface with his hand. The boy watches with a serious, observant expression, resting his hands on the fruit. (3) The camera angle shifts slightly to reveal a second large watermelon next to the first. The man encourages the boy to pat the fruit, and the boy begins tapping on the surface with his palms. (4) The boy leans down, mimicking the man by putting his ear against the second watermelon. He has a curious look, and then breaks into a bright smile as he looks toward the camera. (5) The boy stands centered behind the two watermelons, looking directly into the lens with a happy expression. A large, red variety-style text graphic pops up at the bottom of the screen as the boy finishes his action.
